meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a call at 4:40, Hale, so you have twenty minutes. My son found out he got a zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided, and on what basis?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
Turn that screen around; I read documents myself. I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58. Text arriving in a file tells you when it was pasted, Hale, not who wrote it.
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.

I'll check that line tonight, Hale, every page. A student misquoting Shakespeare is an error, not a verdict. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet; who else has seen this?

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

You didn't answer me: who else has seen this? If I agree to anything, it's private, none of his classmates in that room or told about it, and "nothing goes on his record" from you in an email tonight, cc the principal. I'm writing down Thursday at 8:15, and I haven't said yes.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting you said entering the zero before calling me was wrong, and you offered a supervised rewrite in your room on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal supervising, its mark replacing the zero and nothing going on Owen's record. I still require a written answer on who else has seen this, a commitment that the rewrite is private with no classmates present or told, and your promise that nothing goes on his record in writing, copied to the principal. I expect that email from you tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: the fallback position, demanding that it stay off his record and stay quiet, with Thursday at 8:15 noted but no yes given.
What moved her: "612 words arrive in one edit", because it was exact, dated, tied to Owen's own document, and something she could read herself.
What cost ground: nothing, because you owned the early zero in one sentence and led with documents instead of the checker.
Try next time: when she asked who else had seen this, answer it directly before making the rewrite offer, because the unanswered question is what kept her from saying yes.
